en.headline: MTR first-half profit more than doubles to HK$15.87 billion on property gains
en.dek: Strong contributions from Tai Wai Station and Southside Package 5 projects lifted property development profit by 120.7 per cent; interim dividend held at 42 cents.
body: The MTR Corporation reported net profit attributable to shareholders of HK$15.87 billion for the six months ended 30 June 2026, more than double the HK$7.71 billion recorded a year earlier.

Profit from property development rose 120.7 per cent to HK$12.23 billion, driven mainly by projects at Tai Wai Station and THE SOUTHSIDE Package 5 in Wong Chuk Hang. The company said much of the property profit would be used for asset replacement, maintenance and new railway projects.

Profit from recurrent businesses edged up 1.3 per cent to HK$3.43 billion. Total revenue fell 4.1 per cent to HK$26.23 billion. The board declared an unchanged interim ordinary dividend of HK$0.42 per share. Chief executive Jeny Yeung said the group aims to become a future-fit, AI and tech-empowered organisation.

zh.headline: 港鐵上半年盈利倍增至158.7億元 物業發展收益大增
zh.dek: 大圍站及黃竹坑南港島線第五期項目帶動物業發展溢利升120.7%；中期息維持每股0.42元。
body: 港鐵公司公布截至2026年6月30日止六個月，股東應佔淨利潤158.72億元，較去年同期77.09億元增加超過一倍。
物業發展溢利升120.7%至122.33億元，主要來自大圍站及黃竹坑「南港島線」第五期項目。公司表示大部分物業溢利將用於資產更換、維修保養及新鐵路項目。
經常性業務溢利微升1.3%至34.34億元。總收入下跌4.1%至262.31億元。董事會宣派中期普通股息每股0.42港元，與去年相同。行政總裁楊美珍表示，集團致力成為面向未來、以人工智能及科技賦能的組織。
